title: ‘Youngsters don’t want false promises': Akhilesh Yadav on youth, CJP and recent protests

ai.summary: Akhilesh Yadav stated that Gen Z and younger generations reject false promises and demand clarity on what is possible, following protests that led to an education minister's resignation over examination irregularities.

facts.claim: Gen Z and the younger generation are clear about what they want, Akhilesh Yadav said at HT Leadership Summit, adding that they do not want false promises.
facts.quote: Gen Z and the younger generation are clear about what they want, Akhilesh Yadav said at HT Leadership Summit, adding that they do not want false promises.

facts.claim: The Samajwadi Party has always stood with young people, said party supremo Akhilesh Yadav on Saturday, when asked about his views on the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and the protests led by the outfit, one of which led to the resignation of education minister over examination irregularities.
